text:
maria_cs: Heads-up — planning a 'seatbelt' cookthrough for TitanCorp reserved pool tomorrow 11:00 PST. Goal: validate quota, autoscale behavior, and ramp scripts before the Friday cutover. Need SRE + Platform + SE in the room.

sam_sre: on it. can we confirm the autoscale thresholds? min nodes / max nodes / scale step?

maria_cs: baseline: min=2 nodes, target=8 nodes, max=12 nodes. scale-step=+2 nodes, cool-down 120s. We expect sustained bursts up to ~6k RPS for 10m windows.

lee_platform: got it. will validate node boot times (we saw ~65s from idle in staging last week). if cold-start >90s we should bump min to 3.

olivia_se: FYI TitanCorp asked for <200ms p95 gen latency on small text prompts. that's tight for the qps they plan. We'll show the fallback routing to smaller quantized model if latencies spike.

maria_cs: noted. add that to runbook: fallback-route -> redwood-small-q4. Also capture customer-facing note about potential SLA delta during first 24h.

taylor_ops: what load profile are we running? can someone paste the k6 snippet?

sam_sre: paste below (short):

```
import http from 'k6/http';
export default function () {
  http.post('https://api.redwood/test-gen', JSON.stringify({prompt: 'short'}), {tags:{stage:'seatbelt'}});
}
```
Ramping: 100 -> 6k RPS over 6 minutes, hold 10m, drop 30s. concurrency target ~1200.

maria_cs: also include a KV-cache priming pass: 10k short prompts across the keyspace to ensure warm KV cache.

lee_platform: will run priming before main run. question: quota buckets — do we set per-account throttle or global pool?

olivia_se: TitanCorp purchased a dedicated quota pool (reserved). need to ensure per-account bucket capacity matches their committed qps: 5k steady + 2k burst. map that to quota config: committed=5000, burst=7000, leak_rate smoothing=60s.

sam_sre: ack. I'll patch quota config in staging and post diff.

k8s-bot: deployment scheduled: reserved-pool/titancorp seatbelt-2024-05-04T11:00Z -> staging cluster-3

maria_cs: ops checklist for tomorrow:
- run KV priming 09:50
- apply quota patch 10:10
- run smoke 10:30 (10m @ 200 RPS)
- main seatbelt 11:00 (ramp to 6k)
- post-run regression evals + log sweep 12:30

sam_sre: adding monitoring hooks:
- dashboard: /dash/pools/titancorp (token breakdown, latency p50/p95/p99, GPU util)
- alert: sustained p95 > 800ms for 2m -> notify #eng-oncall + sam_sre
- fallback trigger: >=15% errors or p95 > 1s for 3m -> auto-route 20% to redwood-small-q4

olivia_se: leaving a note for renewal team: if seatbelt shows unstable latency we'll flag as a potential renewal risk — customers saw pressure last quarter. capture decision: do we want to extend a 2-week grace on committed charges if migration impacts throughput?

maria_cs: yes capture that as option B. SE to record observed gaps during post-run notes and product to sign-off on any temporary credits.

taylor_ops: one more ask: can we simulate degraded node scenario? drop 2 nodes mid-run to exercise autoscale recovery.

lee_platform: we can inject a kill at T+7m. autoscaler should provision within cool-down window and maintain SLO if headroom available. will prepare chaos step.

maria_cs: perfect. last ask: please record short clips of the dashboard during the run (screen capture) for TitanCorp postmortem. Olivia, you can use those in the post-demo readout.

olivia_se: will do. I'll also capture customer feedback form link and add a quick 3-question survey after the demo.

sam_sre: diff for quota patch posted: https://git.internal/r/quota/commit/ae34f2 (staging). please review before 10:00.

maria_cs: thanks all — meeting invite going out in 5. ping here if any blockers. :seatbelt: :white_check_mark:

lee_platform: no blockers from infra side. see you tomorrow.

k8s-bot: run started (priming) 2024-05-04T09:50:12Z

maria_cs: post-run note placeholder: will paste results and ops notes here after 12:30 run completion.

sam_sre: post-run: GPU util peaked 92%, p95 latency 320ms during steady 5k RPS, autoscaler added nodes from 2->10 within 140s after chaos injection. KV priming reduced cold-starts by ~70%.

olivia_se: customer feedback: liked the dashboard, asked for sub-50ms p50 on simple prompts — we logged that as a product ask. also appreciated the fallback demo.

maria_cs: summary for renewal: seatbelt successful; slight infra jitter during T+7m chaos but autoscale recovered. recommend proceed with cutover, offer 1-week credit if we see regressions in first 72h.

taylor_ops: ACK — closing the cookthrough. moving notes to playbooks/titancorp-seatbelt-2024-05.json

k8s-bot: ticket #CS-4729 updated: seatbelt run completed
